senses.gloss:
मेठिः, मेथिः
1 A pillar, post.
--2 A
pillar in the midst of a threshing-floor
to which oxen are bound.
--3 A post
to which cattle are bound.
--4 A
prop for supporting the shafts of a
carriage.

मेथ् {c1c} U. (मेथति-ते)
1 To meet.
--2 To meet one another (Atm.).
--3 To revile.
--4 To know,
understand.
--5 To hurt, injure, kill.
मेथिका, मेथिनी A kind of grass.
मेथिका, मेथिनी A kind of grass.
